items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think his name was [Vincent] Persichetti was, at that time . . .

ctx.x: What was the curriculum when you were studying?

I was studying. I was in the orchestra, playing the orchestral repertoire. I had L and M – literature and materials of music. They had one evolution class, which I dropped like a hot potato. I figured, the main thing that I was interested in was the music and how to write music. What’s that guy? I think his name was [Vincent] Persichetti was, at that time . . .
Persichetti. Oh yeah. I played a lot of his . . .
